blocks.text: TOKYO — Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson reflected on her journey to, and in, the 2026 Miss International pageant as the Final Gala nears, an event where her fate will be sealed. The American-Filipino pharmacist from Davao posted on social media, “If only I could go back and tell younger Katrina that her dream would one day bring her here, wearing the name of the country she loves and being cheered on by her kababayans near and far. I don’t think she could’ve imagined that a dream so personal would one day become something she’d get to share with so many […]...
